lines.t:
A robot made up of:
  - the <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c>, which is its brain
  - the <c:ffff00>{{tinpet}}<c>, which works as nerves and skeleton
  - <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> for 4 <c:ffff00>slots<c>:
    <c:ffff00>head<c>, <c:ffff00>right arm<c>, <c:ffff00>left arm<c> and <c:ffff00>legs<c>

Sold mainly as toys, they are common all over the
world.
